picks.editorial_note: A $1.5 billion multi-year NSF initiative adding a dedicated funding call for 'AI for Physical Systems' signals a major national bet on AI-driven breakthrough science, likely to shape research priorities across dozens of institutions.
picks.title: NSF announces 3 additional topics as part of the NSF X-Labs initiative to pursue generational breakthrough science and technology efforts

picks.editorial_note: A $15 million gift from the OpenAI Foundation to UCSF's OpenADMET Consortium to build open-source pharmacokinetic datasets is a notable industry-to-academia investment aimed at training better drug-behavior prediction models.
picks.title: A Gift to Help Scientists Predict How Drugs Behave in the Body

picks.editorial_note: NSF's new ELEGANT program targets translating low-dimensional semiconductor research into U.S. manufacturing, directly addressing the microelectronics supply chain that underpins AI compute infrastructure.
picks.title: NSF invests in translating low-dimensional semiconductor technologies to establish U.S. leadership in microelectronics

picks.editorial_note: SRI's ARPA-H-funded AI 'co-pilot' for rural medical care demonstrates real-world deployment of AI to address specialist shortages, with Reuters coverage underscoring its national visibility.
picks.title: Reuters covers SRI's work in the ARPA-H-funded PARADIGM program - SRI

picks.editorial_note: An international team's protein language model unifying sequence and 3D structure data represents a genuine scientific advance in mapping evolutionary relationships across the protein universe, carrying the week's highest scientific-impact score.
picks.title: Uniting sequence and structure to map the protein universe | Science Tokyo

picks.editorial_note: Integrating EPFL/ETH Zurich's open-source Apertus model into Proton's privacy-focused Lumo assistant exposes academic AI research to tens of millions of users, a rare case of university-built AI reaching mass consumer scale.
picks.title: Apertus partners with Proton's Lumo AI assistant

picks.editorial_note: Rutgers and RWJBarnabas Health's AWS-powered Innovation Hub links a major cloud provider with academic medicine and clinical practice, exemplifying the industry-academia-health system partnerships shaping applied AI.
picks.title: Rutgers and RWJBarnabas Health to Launch Innovation Hub, Powered by Amazon Web Services

picks.editorial_note: NIST's $30 million-plus award to Manufacturing Extension Partnership centers nationwide will help small and medium manufacturers adopt AI and robotics, broadening AI's economic reach beyond research labs.
picks.title: NIST Awards More Than $30 Million for MEP Centers in 11 States and Puerto Rico

picks.editorial_note: A DOE Genesis Mission-funded project applying AI to reason over decades of nuclear waste safety data has direct implications for federal regulatory and environmental policy decisions.
picks.title: AI project reviews nuclear waste safety-case evidence

picks.editorial_note: Purdue's selection among the first cohort of Genesis Mission awardees reflects the rollout of a significant new federal AI research funding program reaching university labs.
picks.title: Category: Research
